features.title: Proto and service contracts compile
features.target: Rust protobuf/gRPC contracts for stream/partition/extent services are available and buildable
features.notes: Current contracts do not include Go-side PartitionKV Batch/StreamPut/Maintenance.

features.title: IO engine backends
features.target: Standard and blocking IO backends work for random read/write/truncate/sync

features.title: Metadata store and owner lock revision model
features.target: In-memory metadata and owner-revision validation support manager APIs

features.title: Stream manager core API parity
features.target: register/create/info/check_commit/alloc/punch/truncate/split work end-to-end

features.title: Etcd mirror, replay, leader election, recovery loops
features.target: Manager can mirror to etcd, replay state, elect leader, dispatch/collect recovery tasks
features.notes: Code path exists; environment-dependent etcd integration tests may fail locally if embedded etcd does not start.

features.title: Extent node API implementation
features.target: Append/read/copy/recovery/availability/heartbeat/df/commit APIs are available

features.title: Stream client write path
features.target: Client append and stream mutation APIs run with owner lock and retry logic

features.title: Partition server KV API and split
features.target: Put/Get/Delete/Head/Range/SplitPart work against manager stream metadata

features.title: Partition flush and restart recovery
features.target: Memtable flush to table and table+WAL replay after restart

features.title: Partition API parity with Go legacy endpoints
features.target: Go-side Batch/StreamPut/Maintenance equivalents are available in Rust
features.notes: Rust proto/service currently does not expose these endpoints.

features.title: Go range_partition advanced storage behaviors
features.target: Compaction/GC/value-log/maintenance lifecycle equivalent to Go range_partition
features.notes: Current Rust partition layer is a simplified table+WAL model.

features.title: Erasure coding parity with Go implementation
features.target: EC encode/decode/recovery path equivalent to Go erasure_code package
features.notes: No standalone Rust EC module observed yet.

features.title: autumn-rs README manual test guide
features.target: Provide a single README in autumn-rs that explains build and manual validation steps

features.title: Standalone server binaries with gRPC reflection
features.target: autumn-manager-server and autumn-extent-node are runnable as independent processes; gRPC reflection enabled so grpcurl works without proto files
features.notes: Validated: grpcurl -plaintext 127.0.0.1:9001 list shows all autumn.v1 services. Service package is autumn.v1, not autumn.

features.title: autumn-stream-cli manual test tool
features.target: Single CLI binary covering the full stream layer manual test cycle: register-node / create-stream / stream-info / append / read
features.notes: Validated end-to-end with 3-replica stream: register 3 nodes, create-stream --data-shard 3, append two blocks, read back both blocks with correct content and byte counts.

features.title: Manager etcd persistence and restart recovery
features.target: autumn-manager-server accepts --etcd endpoints; all metadata survives manager restart; recovery loops activate automatically with etcd
features.notes: Validated: write data → kill manager → restart with --etcd → stream-info returns same extent/replica layout → read returns correct data. Without --etcd falls back to in-memory mode with a WARN log.

features.title: autumn-ps partition server binary
features.target: Standalone partition-server process with gRPC service, etcd-based partition watching/locking, cron-scheduled maintenance (GC/compaction), equivalent to Go cmd/autumn-ps
features.notes: Binary created with --psid/--port/--manager/--data/--advertise flags. Registers with manager, syncs regions, serves PartitionKv gRPC. Missing vs Go: etcd session/lock, cron GC/compact, REST gateway.

features.title: autumn-client admin CLI
features.target: Admin CLI with subcommands: bootstrap, put, get, del, head, ls (range), split, gc, forcegc, compact, info, wbench, rbench, format, equivalent to Go cmd/autumn-client
features.notes: Core subcommands implemented: bootstrap, put, get, del, head, ls, split, info. Routes requests via manager GetRegions (with ps_details). Missing vs Go: gc, forcegc, compact, wbench, rbench, streamput, format, plot.

features.title: Partition Manager complete implementation
features.target: Partition allocation policy, PS node registration with load tracking, region assignment/rebalancing, etcd region watch, equivalent to Go manager/partition_manager
features.notes: Rust has basic PartitionManagerService RPCs (RegisterPs, UpsertPartition, GetRegions) but lacks allocation policy, region watch dispatch, and PS load balancing.

features.title: gRPC connection pool with health check
features.target: Per-address gRPC connection pool with keep-alive heartbeat and lazy creation, equivalent to Go conn/pool.go
features.notes: Rust creates ad-hoc gRPC clients per call. Go has a shared pool with heartbeat-based health checking.

features.title: Multi-disk support and disk format
features.target: Extent node supports multiple disks with UUID identification, disk formatting command, per-disk extent placement, equivalent to Go node/diskfs.go and autumn-client format
features.notes: Rust extent-node uses a single --data directory. Go supports multiple dirs with disk UUIDs and TOML config generation.

features.title: Embedded etcd server in manager
features.target: Manager binary can embed and run its own etcd server for single-node or multi-node clusters, equivalent to Go etcd_utils and cmd/autumn-manager
features.notes: Go manager starts embedded etcd with full cluster config (peer URLs, tokens, etc.). Rust manager connects to external etcd via --etcd flag.

features.title: gRPC Gateway REST API for partition server
features.target: REST HTTP endpoints for Get/Head/Range via gRPC-gateway on partition server, equivalent to Go autumn-ps --gateway-listen
features.notes: Go pspb.proto has HTTP annotations for Get/Head/Range. Rust proto has no REST gateway support.

features.title: Observability: distributed tracing and structured logging
features.target: Jaeger/OpenTelemetry tracing with configurable sampling, structured logging with level control, equivalent to Go xlog and trace-sampler flags
features.notes: Go has Jaeger tracing integration with per-service sampling rates. Rust uses basic tracing_subscriber with no distributed tracing export.

features.title: Stream benchmark CLI tool
features.target: CLI binary with alloc/wbench/plot subcommands for stream layer performance testing, equivalent to Go cmd/stream-client
features.notes: Go stream-client supports multi-thread write benchmarks with latency histograms and gnuplot output. Rust has an in-test benchmark but no standalone CLI.
